column4: Fly Stage 2 prerequisite (deployer report 20261106-2310 section 3: "the entrypoint does not pass the hash yet; Fly is Stage 4b"). git grep of origin/main finds FIELD_INTERNAL_SECRET_SHA256 only in integration/demo/docker-compose.yml (line 29, GB10); integration/fly/entrypoint.sh never exports it to the eight services, so `phase_g_check --stage 2` on Fly cannot read 2 of 2. Pass it through like the compose does (blank by default: unset behaves as before), read from the Fly secret/env, same service set as 852. NOTE tools/tests/fixtures/c5/fly-entrypoint-14fed1e.frozen pins this entrypoint: read the freeze test first and update the fixture the way the freeze rule says, with a reviewer-visible reason; do not weaken the test. Failing test first, one mutant killed, no secret value printed or committed, no .github changes. One branch, one draft PR; report the head SHA.
